title: Plaits
_comment: Mutable Instruments Plaits (engines/plaits/): the engines the genres use. HARMONICS, TIMBRE and MORPH mean something different on each engine; the device names them (web/app/devices/plaits.js).

params.name: Engine
params.help: How Plaits makes its sound: analogue, FM, wavetables, chords, strings, speech, resonators.

params.name: Harmonics
params.help: The first of Plaits' three knobs: what it does depends on the engine (see its name).

params.name: Timbre
params.help: The second knob, usually brightness: cutoff, modulation, density.

params.name: Morph
params.help: The third knob, usually the shape: waveform, feedback, decay.

params.name: Decay
params.help: How long notes ring after their note off, and how fast the envelope sweeps.

params.name: LPG colour
params.help: The low-pass gate: low closes like a filter (soft, woody), high like a VCA (bright).

params.name: Attack
params.help: How long a note takes to swell in: short for plucks, long for pads.

params.name: Timbre envelope
params.help: How much each note's envelope moves TIMBRE: up for a pluck that opens, down to close.

params.name: Morph envelope
params.help: How much each note's envelope moves MORPH.

params.name: Transpose
params.help: Moves the part up or down in semitones: -12 for a bass an octave down.

params.name: Preset
params.help: The preset the part started from (the device marks it * once you change it).
